author: Dale Philip
description: I explored the site where Batavia Castle used to stand in Jakarta's old town. All that remains is an old warehouse building. The local kids told me there is a ghost of a Dutch lady living inside it, and she likes to scare kids, but if they are polite and don't bother her, she won't bother them.
title: Haunted Dutch Building in Jakarta, Indonesia 🇮🇩
